title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Acts 7: Stephen's account of Abraham, Joseph and Moses before the council, and his death outside the city.

questions.text: Where was Abraham when the God of glory appeared to him?
questions.explanation: Stephen says the God of glory appeared to Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran.

answers.text: In Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran
In the land of Egypt, before Joseph
In Shechem, in the land of Canaan
In the wilderness of Mount Sinai

questions.text: For how long did God say Abraham's offspring would be enslaved and mistreated?
questions.explanation: God said his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land and be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

questions.text: What did the patriarchs do to Joseph out of jealousy?
questions.explanation: The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt, and God was with him.

answers.text: They drove him into the wilderness

questions.text: How many souls did Joseph summon when he sent for his father and relatives?
questions.explanation: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

questions.text: Who took Moses up and reared him as her own son?
questions.explanation: When Moses was thrown out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

questions.text: Where did Moses flee and become a stranger?
questions.explanation: Moses fled at this saying and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

answers.text: Back to the land of Egypt

questions.text: What did the Lord tell Moses to do at the burning bush?
questions.explanation: The Lord told him to take off his sandals, because the place where he stood was holy ground.

answers.text: To hide his face from the fire

questions.text: What did the fathers make in those days when they turned back in their hearts to Egypt?
questions.explanation: They made a calf in those days, brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

answers.text: A calf, and brought a sacrifice to it
A house for the God of Jacob

questions.text: What did Stephen say he saw as he looked up into heaven?
questions.explanation: He said he saw the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God.

answers.text: The Son of Man standing at the right hand of God
An angel of the Lord in a flame of fire
The glory of the temple in Jerusalem
A cloud receiving him out of sight

questions.text: At whose feet did the witnesses place their garments?
questions.explanation: They threw Stephen out of the city and stoned him, and the witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

answers.text: At the feet of the high priest
At the feet of the elders
At the feet of a young man named Saul
At the feet of the scribes
